methodologyNotes: Roster covers ten high-search pressure washer models spanning entry-level electric, mid-range electric brushless, and residential gas units: Sun Joe SPX3000, Ryobi RY142300, Karcher K5 Premium (1.603-361.0), Karcher K1700, Greenworks GPW2000, Greenworks Pro GPW3000, Simpson MegaShot MS60773, Westinghouse WPX3200, DeWalt DWPW2400, and Active 2.0. Specs sourced from manufacturer product pages (shopjoe.com, kaercher.com, dewalt.com, westinghouse.com, simpsoncleaning.com, activeproducts.com), the pressurewasherdb.com specialist database, and major retail listings (Home Depot, Walmart, Lowes, Direct Tools Outlet, Amazon). PSI and GPM reflect certified/rated figures where available, not peak-marketing figures; weight is dry/without water. Adversarially re-verified 2026-06-15: all ten models confirmed to exist; two price corrections applied (Active 2.0 tool-only price corrected to official $319.99; Karcher K5 Premium price nulled because the model is discontinued and no current published USD price is verifiable). All other headline specs corroborated across the cited source plus at least one independent retailer/review. accessedAt 2026-06-15.

products.name: Sun Joe SPX3000
products.priceNote: Typical current retail at Walmart; pressurewasherdb shows $143.65-$169.99 range
products.provenance: PSI (2030 PWMA-certified/rated), GPM (1.2 rated; retailers also market 1.76 as max), 13-amp universal motor (Home Depot PWMA listing confirms 13A; some listings cite 14.5A peak), 20 ft hose, 5 nozzles (0/15/25/40/soap), 24.3 lbs, and $169 Walmart price all confirmed on pressurewasherdb.com and the official shopjoe.com page. Verified 2026-06-15.

products.name: Ryobi RY142300
products.priceNote: Original MSRP per pressurist.com review; current Direct Tools Outlet (factory blemished) price $249.99; some Home Depot listings ~$379
products.provenance: 2300 PSI, 1.2 GPM, 13A brushless motor (Ryobi's own 'brushless induction' marketing term), 25 ft hose, 3 nozzles (15/soap/turbo), 49 lbs confirmed via pressurist.com review and Direct Tools Outlet listing; weight independently corroborated by Consumer Reports/techgearlab. Release year 2018 from contemporaneous review articles (approximate; manufacturer lists no exact date). MSRP $279 per review; current verifiable price $249.99 at Direct Tools Outlet. Verified 2026-06-15.

products.name: Karcher K5 Premium

products.provenance: Karcher outlet page confirms model 1.603-361.0 is discontinued ('no longer in our current product range'). Verified 2026-06-15.
